## Scope and source notes

CAMT053 can be ordered in Online Banking; LLB Connect explicitly supports 053/054 with an account, E-Banking access, Connect agreement and compatible ERP. The separate PSD2 JSON API is not a CAMT sample source. No public raw original or ISO version verified.

No open redistribution licence established. Consult the publisher before republishing originals.

### LLB Connect — Accounting integration

**Optional automation · Documented service · CAMT / CODA files**

**Formats:** camt.053; camt.054. **Scope:** Europe / Liechtenstein.

**Setup / access:** Requires an LLB account, E-Banking access, LLB Connect agreement and compatible ERP/financial software.
